name: Subclass features
blurb: Every subclass beyond the free rules gets its features on the sheet and at level up, with always-prepared spells and a one-line playstyle.
contents: 59 subclasses from the Player’s Handbook, Heroes of Faerûn, The Horrors Within, Arcana Unleashed and D&D Beyond Drops
309 subclass features, shown at the right levels
A playstyle line for every subclass when you choose one
about: Feature texts are summaries from your classes workbook; check the book for exact wording. Subclasses from the free rules keep their full text.

classFeatures: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as Rituals (Wis).

Each Rage pick: Bear (Resistance to all damage except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant), Eagle (Dash + Disengage when you rage, and as a Bonus Action after), or Wolf (allies have Advantage vs enemies within 5 ft of you).
Choose one, change on Long Rest: Owl (Darkvision 60 ft or +60), Panther (Climb Speed = Speed), Salmon (Swim Speed = Speed).
Cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual (Wis).
Each Rage pick: Falcon (Fly Speed = Speed if no armor), Lion (enemies within 5 ft have Disadvantage attacking others), Ram (melee hits knock Large-or-smaller targets Prone).
Rage grants temp HP = Barbarian level. Each turn while raging, give a creature within 10 ft temp HP = d6s equal to Rage Damage (lost when Rage ends).
Reaction while raging: a creature starting its turn within 30 ft makes a Str save or is teleported next to you and its Speed becomes 0 for the turn.
+10 ft reach with Heavy or Versatile melee weapons; can apply Push or Topple mastery in addition to the weapon's own.
While raging, Bonus Action teleport 60 ft (also on entering Rage). Once per Rage: 150 ft and bring up to 6 willing creatures within 10 ft.
While raging, first hit each turn deals +1d6 + half Barbarian level Necrotic or Radiant.
Pool of healing d12s (4 at L3, 5 at L6, 6 at L12, 7 at L17); Bonus Action: spend dice to heal yourself. Resets on Long Rest.
Once per Rage, reroll a failed save with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage.
Bonus Action: up to 10 creatures within 60 ft get Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn. 1/Long Rest or expend a Rage use.
On entering Rage, 1 min divine form: Fly Speed = Speed (hover); Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant; Reaction + Rage use to set an ally dropping to 0 HP to HP = Barbarian level. 1/Long Rest.

Unarmored, no Shield: Advantage on dance Performance; AC 10 + Dex + Cha; when you expend Bardic Inspiration as part of an action/BA/Reaction, also make an Unarmed Strike; Unarmed Strikes use Dex and deal a Bardic Inspiration die roll + Dex Bludgeoning (die not expended).
Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 ft: expend Bardic Inspiration, move half Speed and an ally within 30 ft can also move half Speed (no OAs).
On Initiative, expend Bardic Inspiration: roll it and add to the Initiative of you and allies within 30 ft.
Evasion; creatures within 5 ft of you making the same Dex save also gain it.

Charm Person and Mirror Image always prepared. After casting an Enchantment/Illusion spell with a slot, a creature within 60 ft makes a Wis save or is Charmed or Frightened 1 min. 1/Long Rest or expend Bardic Inspiration.
Bonus Action, expend Bardic Inspiration: up to Cha mod creatures within 60 ft gain temp HP = 2× the roll and can use their Reaction to move up to their Speed without OAs.
Command always prepared. Bonus Action: cast Command free, and for 1 min cast it as a Bonus Action each turn without a slot; creatures you've Charmed auto-fail. 1/Long Rest or level 3+ slot.
Bonus Action, 1 min: the first time a creature hits you each turn it makes a Cha save or the attack misses. 1/Short or Long Rest.
Know Guidance (60 ft range); use playing cards, crystal ball/orb, candle or ink pen as a Bard focus.

When you give Bardic Inspiration, roll it to channel a spirit (or Bonus Action + 1 use to choose one ≤ your die). Magic action: unleash it on a creature within 30 ft — 12 effects incl. healing (Beloved/Priest), Force damage (Sharpshooter), teleport (Renegade), Advantage (Fortune Teller), Charm/Fear/Prone/Fire blasts (Trickster/Coward/Brute/Arsonist).
Once per turn +1d6 to a Bard slot spell's damage or healing. Spirit Guardians always prepared; cast free 1/Long Rest and optionally give you and allies in it Half Cover (1/Short Rest).
Roll twice on the Spirits from Beyond table and choose; on doubles pick any spirit.
Creatures with your Bardic Inspiration can add the die to a weapon damage roll, or to AC as a Reaction when hit.
Martial weapons, Medium armor and Shields; use a weapon as a spellcasting focus.
Attack twice per Attack action; one attack can be replaced by a cantrip.
After casting a spell with an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

Inspired Eclipse: when you give Bardic Inspiration, also become Invisible (until your next turn or you attack/damage/cast) and teleport 30 ft. Lunar Vitality: once per turn when a spell heals, expend Bardic Inspiration to add the roll and +10 ft Speed.
Learn Druidic and one Druid cantrip (free, counts as Bard); proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception or Survival.
Moonbeam always prepared. 1/Long Rest modify it: each time a creature fails its save, another creature within 60 ft regains 2d4 HP.
Inspired Eclipse also lets the inspired creature turn Invisible and teleport 30 ft (Reaction); Lunar Vitality can use a d6 instead of spending a Bardic Inspiration die.
Always prepared — L3: Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Magic Weapon, Nystul's Magic Aura; L5: Counterspell, Dispel Magic; L7: Arcane Eye, Leomund's Secret Chest; L9: Bigby's Hand, Teleportation Circle

Channel Divinity (no action) when casting a spell: Fortifying Spell (one target gains 2d8 + Cleric level temp HP) or Tenacious Spell (a creature that succeeds on the spell's save subtracts 1d6 from its next save against it).
Proficiency in Arcana (or another Cleric skill); learn two Wizard cantrips (swap on level up).
Right after casting a slot spell that heals or ends a condition, cast Dispel Magic free as part of the same action. 1/Short or Long Rest; restore with Channel Divinity.
Learn one Wizard spell each of levels 6, 7, 8 and 9; always prepared (swap on level up).
Always prepared — L3: Detect Evil and Good, False Life, Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spare the Dying; L5: Revivify, Vampiric Touch; L7: Blight, Death Ward; L9: Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead
Pull of Death: once per turn +1d4 Necrotic (1d6 at L11) vs a target missing HP. Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action. Healing dice on a creature at 0 HP use max values.
Channel Divinity, Bonus Action: curse a creature within 30 ft until your next turn — Disadvantage on attacks and saves; end it when an ally hits for + Cleric level Necrotic or Radiant.
Reaction when you or a Bloodied creature within 60 ft is hit: halve the damage and cancel crit effects. Wis mod uses per Long Rest.

Enhanced Necromancy: Channel Divinity to add a second target to a single-target Necromancy spell (≤ level 5) or Grave spell. Keeper of Souls: when an enemy dies within 60 ft, you or an ally regains 2× Cleric level HP (1/Short Rest or level 6+ slot).
One Artisan's Tools; proficiency and Expertise in two of Arcana, History, Nature, Religion.

Always prepared — L3: Command, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Identify, Mind Spike; L5: Dispel Magic, Nondetection, Tongues; L7: Arcane Eye, Banishment, Confusion; L9: Legend Lore, Scrying, Synaptic Static
Channel Divinity, Magic action: cast a prepared Divination spell from your domain list without a slot or Material components.
Telepathy 60 ft with up to Wis mod creatures at once; Int save proficiency (or another save).
Bonus Action: Advantage on D20 Tests for 1 hour. 1/Long Rest or level 6+ slot.
Always prepared — L3: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility; L5: Daylight, Fireball; L7: Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire; L9: Flame Strike, Scrying
Channel Divinity, Magic action: dispel magical Darkness within 30 ft; chosen creatures in 30 ft make a Con save, 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant (half on success).
Reaction: impose Disadvantage on an attack against you or a creature within 30 ft. Wis mod uses per Long Rest.
Warding Flare recharges on a Short Rest and gives the target 2d6 + Wis mod temp HP.
Magic action, 1 min: 60-ft sunlight; enemies in it have Disadvantage on saves vs Radiance of the Dawn and your Fire/Radiant spells. Wis mod uses per Long Rest.
Magic action: you or a willing creature within 30 ft gains Advantage on Stealth checks until your next Long Rest.
Channel Divinity, Bonus Action: illusory double within 30 ft for 1 min. Cast spells from its space; Advantage on attacks vs creatures within 5 ft of it; move it 30 ft as a Bonus Action.
Always prepared — L3: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace; L5: Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection; L7: Confusion, Dimension Door; L9: Dominate Person, Modify Memory
When you create or move your double, you can swap places with it by teleporting.
Allies also get Advantage vs creatures within 5 ft of the double; when it ends, you or a creature within 5 ft of it regains HP = Cleric level.
Channel Divinity: when you or a creature within 30 ft misses an attack, add +10 to the roll (Reaction for others).
Always prepared — L3: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon; L5: Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians; L7: Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement; L9: Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike
Bonus Action: one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike. Wis mod uses, regain on a Short or Long Rest.
Expend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot; no Concentration, lasts 1 min.
Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
Wild Shape max CR = Druid level ÷ 3 (round down); AC is at least 13 + Wis mod; temp HP = 3× Druid level.
Always prepared — L3: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp (castable in Wild Shape); L5: Conjure Animals; L7: Fount of Moonlight; L9: Mass Cure Wounds
Wild Shape attacks can deal Radiant damage; add Wis mod to Con saves.
Bonus Action: teleport 30 ft and gain Advantage on your next attack this turn. Wis mod uses per Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ slot.
Once per turn +2d10 Radiant on a Wild Shape hit; Moonlight Step can bring a willing creature within 10 ft.
Always prepared — L3: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Thunderwave; L5: Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing; L7: Control Water, Ice Storm; L9: Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster
Bonus Action, expend Wild Shape: 5-ft Emanation for 10 min. Bonus Action each turn: a creature in it makes a Con save or takes Wis-mod d6s Cold and is pushed 15 ft (Large or smaller).
Wrath of the Sea Emanation becomes 10 ft; Swim Speed = Speed.
While Wrath of the Sea is active: Fly Speed = Speed; Resistance to Cold, Lightning, Thunder.
Grant your Wrath of the Sea Emanation to a willing creature within 60 ft instead (or both by spending 2 Wild Shape uses).
Star chart focus; Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared; cast Guiding Bolt without a slot Wis mod times per Long Rest.

Bonus Action, expend Wild Shape, 10 min: Archer (Bonus Action 60-ft ranged spell attack, 1d8 + Wis Radiant), Chalice (when you heal with a slot, another creature within 30 ft heals 1d8 + Wis), Dragon (Int/Wis checks and Concentration saves: treat 9 or lower as 10).
After a Long Rest roll for Weal (even) or Woe (odd). Reaction: add or subtract 1d6 to a D20 Test within 30 ft. Wis mod uses.
Archer and Chalice become 2d8; Dragon grants Fly 20 ft (hover); change constellation at the start of each turn.
In Starry Form: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation (Int); proficiency in Arcana and Nature.

Know 2 shot options (+1 at L7, L10, L15, L18); once per turn apply one to an Ammunition attack. Uses = Int mod per Short/Long Rest. Arcane Shot die d6 (d8 L10, d10 L15, d12 L18). Options: Banishing, Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping, Piercing, Seeking, Shadow. DC 8 + Int + PB.
Bonus Action after a ranged miss: reroll the attack against another creature within 60 ft of the first.
Magic action: fire enchanted ammo at a surface — Darkening (15-ft dim zone, −5 Perception), Unlocking (opens a lock), or Vine (120-ft climbable vine). 1/Short or Long Rest or spend a Second Wind use.
Regain one Arcane Shot use when you roll Initiative.
When Indomitable succeeds, teleport up to 60 ft.
Reaction when a creature misses you: move half Speed without OAs, then make a ranged attack against it.
Comprehend Languages as a Ritual (Cha); learn a language (swap daily); proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion or Performance.
When you use Second Wind, up to Cha mod allies within 30 ft regain 1d4 + Fighter level HP. 1/Short or Long Rest.
Allies healed by Group Recovery have Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn.
When you Action Surge, up to Cha mod allies within 30 ft can use a Reaction to attack once or move half Speed without OAs.
Reaction when an ally within 60 ft fails a save: spend an Indomitable use; it rerolls adding your Fighter level.
Group Recovery and Rallying Surge reach 60 ft; immunity to Charmed and Frightened.
Learn 3 maneuvers; 4 Superiority Dice (d8), regain on Short/Long Rest. +1 die at L7 and L15; +2 maneuvers at L7, L10, L15. Save DC 8 + Str or Dex + PB.
Proficiency with one Artisan's Tools and one Fighter skill.
Bonus Action: learn a creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (within 30 ft). 1/Long Rest or spend a Superiority Die.
Once per turn when you use a maneuver, roll 1d8 instead of expending a die.
Int caster from the Wizard list: 2 cantrips (3 at L10), 3 prepared spells rising to 13 at L20; slots up to level 4 (third-caster table).
1-hour ritual bonds up to 2 weapons: you can't be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a Bonus Action.
When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with a cantrip.
A weapon hit gives the target Disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.
When you Action Surge, teleport up to 30 ft.
Replace two attacks with a level 1 or 2 spell (action cast time).

Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 (6d8 at L5, 8d8 L9, 8d10 L11, 10d10 L13, 12d12 L17); regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long. Protective Field (Reaction: reduce damage by die + Int), Psionic Strike (once/turn +die + Int Force), Telekinetic Movement (Magic action: move object/creature 30 ft).
Psi-Powered Leap (Bonus Action: Fly = 2× Speed this turn) and Telekinetic Thrust (Psionic Strike target: Str save or Prone / pushed 10 ft).
Resistance to Psychic; expend a die to end Charmed or Frightened at the start of your turn.
Bonus Action: up to Int mod creatures within 30 ft gain Half Cover for 1 min. 1/Long Rest or expend a die.
Cast Telekinesis without a slot (1/Long Rest or a die); while concentrating on it, make a weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

3 d8 dice (4 d10 at L10, 5 d12 at L15), regain on Short/Long Rest. On a weapon hit spend one: +die Psychic and an effect — Abandoned (Int save or Deafened, treats all as enemies) or Dread (Disadvantage on next save). DC 8 + Wis + PB.
Darkvision 60 ft (or +60). Magic action: read a creature's dominant emotion within 30 ft (Wis save). Wis mod uses per Long Rest.
With Tactical Shift, teleport 30 ft instead; chosen creatures within 10 ft make a Wis save or take a Despairing die of Psychic and are Frightened. 1/Short or Long Rest.
New Despairing Strike options: Apathetic (Wis save or Incapacitated), Lost (Cha save or Blinded + Speed 0), Weary (Con save or 1 Exhaustion, temporary).
Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic; Con save (DC 15, +5 each time) to resist HP-maximum reduction.
When you Action Surge, 1 min: Reaction to reduce an attack's damage to 0; immunity to Charmed and Frightened.
Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 FP: +Martial Arts die + Wis mod Necrotic.
Magic action, 1 FP: touch heals Martial Arts die + Wis mod. Can replace a Flurry of Blows strike with it (no FP for the heal).
Proficiency in Insight, Medicine and the Herbalism Kit.
Hand of Harm also Poisons until your next turn; Hand of Healing also ends Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.
Replace each Flurry strike with Hand of Healing (no FP); add Hand of Harm to a Flurry strike without FP, Wis mod times per Long Rest.
Magic action, 5 FP: revive a creature dead under 24 hours with 4d10 + Wis mod HP and conditions removed. 1/Long Rest.
1 FP: cast Darkness (you can see through it, move it each turn); Darkvision 60 ft (or +60); know Minor Illusion (Wis).
Bonus Action: teleport 60 ft between Dim Light/Darkness spaces; Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.
Spend 1 FP to Shadow Step without the light requirement; make an Unarmed Strike after teleporting.
Magic action, 3 FP, 1 min: Invisible in Dim Light/Darkness, move through creatures/objects, Flurry of Blows costs no FP.
Start of turn, 1 FP, 10 min: Unarmed Strike reach +10 ft; hits can deal Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder and push or pull 10 ft (Str save).
Magic action, 2 FP: 20-ft-radius sphere within 120 ft, Dex save, 3 Martial Arts dice of a chosen element (half on success).
While attuned: Fly and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
While attuned: Resistance to a chosen element; Step of the Wind adds +20 ft and damages creatures you pass; once per turn +Martial Arts die elemental damage on a strike.
Wis caster from the Sorcerer list: 2 cantrips (3 at L10), 3 prepared spells rising to 13; slots up to level 4 (third-caster table). Arcane Focus.
When you take the Attack action, replace one Unarmed Strike with a Sorcerer cantrip (action cast time).
Expend a slot to regain FP = slot level. On a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, spend FP to recover a slot (L1: 2 FP, L2: 3, L3: 5 at L13, L4: 6 at L19).
After Stunning Strike (hit or not), the target has Disadvantage on saves vs your spells until your next turn.
With Flurry of Blows, replace two strikes with a level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell (action cast time).
After casting Divine Smite, expend Channel Divinity: split 2d8 + Paladin level temp HP among creatures within 30 ft.
Always prepared — L3: Guiding Bolt, Heroism; L5: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon; L9: Haste, Protection from Energy; L13: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement; L17: Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence
Channel Divinity, Bonus Action, 1 hr: Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics; +10 ft jump distance.
+10 ft Speed; allies starting/entering your aura gain +10 ft Speed until end of their next turn.
Reaction when you or a creature within 10 ft is hit: add Cha mod to AC; if it misses, attack the attacker. Cha mod uses per Long Rest.
Bonus Action, 10 min: Advantage on Cha checks; once per turn turn a missed attack into a hit; Reaction to reroll a failed save. 1/Long Rest or level 5 slot.
When you take the Attack action, expend Channel Divinity: Advantage on attacks vs one creature within 30 ft for 1 min; transfers if it drops to 0 HP.
Always prepared — L3: Bane, Hunter's Mark; L5: Hold Person, Misty Step; L9: Haste, Protection from Energy; L13: Banishment, Dimension Door; L17: Hold Monster, Scrying
When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, the target's Speed becomes 0 and you can move half your Speed without provoking.
Reaction: when your Vow of Enmity target attacks, make a melee attack against it.
Bonus Action, 10 min: Fly 60 ft (hover); enemies starting a turn in your aura make a Wis save or are Frightened 1 min and attacks vs them have Advantage. 1/Long Rest or level 5 slot.
Channel Divinity, Magic action: chosen creatures in a 15-ft Emanation make a Str save or are Restrained 1 min (repeat save each turn).
Always prepared — L3: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals; L5: Misty Step, Moonbeam; L9: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy; L13: Ice Storm, Stoneskin; L17: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride
You and allies in your aura have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.
At 0 HP (not killed outright), drop to 1 HP instead and regain 3× Paladin level HP. 1/Long Rest. You can't be magically aged.
Bonus Action, 1 min: regain 10 HP each turn; cast action spells as a Bonus Action; enemies in your aura have Disadvantage on saves vs your spells and Channel Divinity. 1/Long Rest or level 5 slot.

After Divine Smite, expend Channel Divinity: Dao's Crush (Grappled + Restrained), Djinni's Escape (teleport 30 ft, resist B/P/S, immune Grappled/Prone/Restrained), Efreeti's Fury (+2d4 Fire, leaps 2d4 to another), or Marid's Surge (Str save: push 15 ft + Prone in 10 ft).

Always prepared — L3: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite; L5: Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force; L9: Fly, Gaseous Form; L13: Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental; L17: Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane
Unarmored AC = 10 + Dex + Cha (Shield allowed); proficiency in Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.
You and allies in your aura have Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (change at the start of each turn).
Reaction when hit: halve the damage; attacker makes a Dex save or takes 2d10 + Cha elemental damage (half on success). Cha mod uses per Long Rest.
Bonus Action, 10 min: Fly 60 ft (hover); Reaction to turn a failed D20 Test by you or an ally in your aura into a success. 1/Long Rest or level 5 slot.
Beast of the Land, Sea or Sky (AC 13 + Wis, HP 5 + 5× Ranger level). Dodges unless commanded (Bonus Action, or replace one of your attacks). Revive with a Magic action + slot within 1 hour.
When commanded, the beast can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help as a Bonus Action; its attacks can deal Force damage.
Beast's Strike attacks twice; its first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target adds that spell's damage as Force.
Spells you cast targeting yourself can also affect your beast within 30 ft.
Once per turn on a weapon hit, +1d4 Psychic (1d6 at L11).
Always prepared — L3: Charm Person; L5: Misty Step; L9: Summon Fey; L13: Dimension Door; L17: Mislead
Cosmetic fey blessing (choose or roll on a d6 table); no mechanical effect.
Add Wis mod (min +1) to Cha checks; proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.
Advantage on saves vs Charmed/Frightened. Reaction when a creature within 120 ft succeeds on such a save: another creature makes a Wis save or is Charmed or Frightened 1 min.
Cast Summon Fey once per Long Rest without a slot or material; can drop Concentration (lasts 1 min).
Cast Misty Step without a slot Wis mod times per Long Rest; bring one willing creature within 5 ft.
+10 ft Speed on your first turn of combat; add Wis mod to Initiative; Dreadful Strike: once per turn +2d6 Psychic on a weapon hit, Wis mod uses per Long Rest.
Always prepared — L3: Disguise Self; L5: Rope Trick; L9: Fear; L13: Greater Invisibility; L17: Seeming
Darkvision 60 ft (or +60); while in Darkness you're Invisible to creatures relying on Darkvision.
Proficiency in Wis saves (or Int/Cha if you have it).
Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8 and adds Sudden Strike (extra attack on a creature within 5 ft) or Mass Fear (target and creatures within 10 ft: Wis save or Frightened).
Reaction when a creature attacks you: impose Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 ft whether it hits or misses.
Always prepared — L3: Wrathful Smite; L5: Alter Self; L9: Phantom Steed; L13: Dominate Beast; L17: Steel Wind Strike
Bonus Action + a Favored Enemy use, 1 min: +1 AC (+2 at L11); Opportunity Attack when a creature within 5 ft damages you or an ally; 10-ft aura — chosen creatures make Wis saves or are Frightened.
Add Wis mod to Con saves. While transformed and Bloodied, once per turn on a hit regain 1d10 + Wis HP.
Creatures failing your aura save also can't heal or take Reactions; weapon hits can add Sap or Slow mastery on top of the weapon's own.
+Wis mod damage vs Frightened creatures; immune to Exhaustion; at 0 HP while transformed drop to 2× Ranger level HP instead (1/Long Rest or level 4+ slot).
Resistance to Cold; your attacks, spells and features ignore Cold Resistance; once per turn +1d4 Cold on a weapon hit (1d6 at L11).
Casting Hunter's Mark grants 1d10 + Ranger level temp HP; marked creatures can't take Disengage.
Always prepared — L3: Ice Knife; L5: Hold Person; L9: Remove Curse; L13: Ice Storm; L17: Cone of Cold
Magic action: up to Wis mod creatures regain 1d10 + Ranger level HP and get Advantage vs Frightened for 1 hour. 1/Long Rest.
Reaction when hit: attacker makes a Wis save or is Stunned (Speed 0) until end of your next turn. Wis mod uses per Long Rest.

When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form: immune to Cold, 2d4 Cold to chosen creatures within 15 ft each turn, immune to Grappled/Prone/Restrained, move through creatures/objects. 1/Long Rest or level 4+ slot.
Int caster from the Wizard list: Mage Hand + 2 cantrips (3 at L10), 3 prepared spells rising to 13; slots up to level 4.
Cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action, make it Invisible, control it as a Bonus Action and use Sleight of Hand through it.
If you're Invisible when you cast a spell, targets have Disadvantage on saves against it.
Your Trip Cunning Strike can also target a creature within 5 ft of your Mage Hand.
Reaction after a spell targets you: caster makes an Int save vs your DC; on a failure you negate it and can prepare that spell for 8 hours (caster can't cast it). 1/Long Rest.
Advantage on Initiative; Advantage on attacks vs creatures that haven't acted in round 1; Sneak Attack in round 1 adds damage = Rogue level.
Proficiency with the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.
Mimic speech/handwriting after studying it; Steady Aim no longer sets your Speed to 0.
Poison Cunning Strike adds 2d6 Poison damage that ignores Resistance.
Sneak Attack in round 1: target makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex + PB) or the attack's damage is doubled.
Right after Sneak Attack on your turn, a second creature within 30 ft takes Necrotic = half your Sneak Attack dice. Dex mod uses per Long Rest.
After a Short/Long Rest gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack (replaces the previous one).

Hold soul trinkets (2; 3 at L13, 4 at L17): Advantage on Death and Con saves while holding one; destroy one for a free Wails or to cast Augury/ask its spirit a question. Reaction to gain one when a creature dies within 30 ft.
Cast Speak with Dead free 1/Short or Long Rest; can target a soul trinket.
Bonus Action, 10 min: Fly 10 ft (hover), attacks vs you have Disadvantage, move through creatures/objects. 1/Long Rest or destroy a trinket.
Wails from the Grave damages both creatures; gain a trinket on Initiative if you have none.
Reaction when an enemy within 30 ft becomes Bloodied (not killed): teleport next to it and make a melee attack. Int mod uses per Long Rest.
Choose (change on Long Rest): Bane (Psychic Resistance, Minor Illusion), Bhaal (Poison Resistance, Blade Ward) or Myrkul (Necrotic Resistance, Chill Touch).
New Cunning Strike — Terrify (1d6): Wis save or Frightened 1 min; you have Advantage on attacks vs it.
When Bloodthirst teleports you, a creature within 10 ft of either space takes Int mod damage of your Allegiance type (ignores Resistance).
Regain one Bloodthirst use on a Short Rest; Sneak Attack dice of 1 or 2 count as 3.
Psionic Energy Dice (4d6 → 12d12 by L17; regain 1 on Short Rest). Psi-Bolstered Knack (add a die to a failed proficient check), Psychic Whispers (telepathy with up to PB creatures).
Manifest blades: Finesse, Thrown 60 ft, 1d6 Psychic, Vex mastery; Bonus Action second blade 1d4.
Homing Strikes (add a die to a missed blade attack) and Psychic Teleportation (Bonus Action: throw blade, teleport 10× die roll ft).
Magic action: Invisible for 1 hour (ends if you deal damage or force a save). 1/Long Rest or expend a die.
Sneak Attack with Psychic Blades: Wis save or Stunned 1 min (repeat save each turn). 1/Long Rest or 3 dice.

Always prepared — L3: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver; L5: Hunger of Hadar, Sending; L7: Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration; L9: Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis
Bonus Action: telepathic link with a creature within 30 ft for minutes = Sorcerer level (range: Cha mod miles).
Cast Psionic Spells by spending Sorcery Points = spell level instead of a slot, with no Verbal/Somatic components.
Resistance to Psychic damage; Advantage on saves vs Charmed and Frightened.
Bonus Action, spend 1+ SP, 10 min: one benefit per point — swim + water breathing, fly (hover), see invisible within 60 ft, or squeeze through 1-inch gaps.
Magic action: teleport 120 ft; creatures within 30 ft of where you left make a Str save, 3d10 Force and pulled in (half on success). 1/Long Rest or 5 SP.

Always prepared — L3: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good; L5: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy; L7: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct; L9: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force
Reaction: cancel Advantage or Disadvantage on a d20 roll within 60 ft. Cha mod uses per Long Rest.
Magic action, spend 1–5 SP: ward a creature within 30 ft with that many d8s; roll them to reduce damage it takes.
Bonus Action, 1 min: attacks vs you can't have Advantage and your D20 Test rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. 1/Long Rest or 5 SP.
Magic action, 30-ft Cube: restore up to 100 HP split among creatures, repair objects, end spells of level 6 or lower. 1/Long Rest or 7 SP.
Always prepared — L3: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace; L5: Hunger of Hadar, Nondetection; L7: Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer; L9: Contagion, Creation
Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 10 ft, see through your own Darkness. Strength of the Grave: at 0 HP, Cha save (DC 5 + damage) to go to Cha mod + Sorcerer level HP instead (1/Long Rest on success).
3 SP: cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action without a slot; enemies within 5 ft of it have Disadvantage on saves vs your spells. Can skip Concentration (1 min).
In Dim Light/Darkness, Bonus Action: teleport 120 ft to another dim/dark space.
When you use Innate Sorcery, take shadow form: Resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant; move through creatures/objects. 1/Long Rest or 6 SP.
Once per turn when you spend 1+ SP as a Magic/Bonus Action: Bolstering Flames (1d4 + Cha temp HP to a creature within 30 ft) or Radiant Fire (1d4 Fire or Radiant to a creature within 30 ft).
Always prepared — L3: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray; L5: Aura of Vitality, Dispel Magic; L7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; L9: Flame Strike, Greater Restoration
Counterspell always prepared; regain 1d4 SP when a target fails its save against your Counterspell.
Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level; Radiant Fire becomes 1d8.
When you use Innate Sorcery: Fly 60 ft (hover); once per turn spend Hit Dice (up to Cha mod) to reduce an attack's damage; Evasion-style half/no damage on saves. 1/Long Rest or 5 SP.
Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20 roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.
Gain Advantage on one D20 Test. Recharges on a Long Rest, or after you cast a slot spell (which triggers an automatic surge).
Reaction, 1 SP: add or subtract 1d4 to another creature's d20 roll.
When you roll on the Surge table, roll twice and choose.
After casting a slot spell, choose any Surge table effect (not the final row). 1/Long Rest.
Always prepared — L3: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Sleep; L5: Blink, Plant Growth; L7: Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility; L9: Dominate Person, Seeming

Cast Misty Step without a slot Cha mod times per Long Rest, adding Refreshing Step (1d10 temp HP to you or a creature within 10 ft) or Taunting Step (nearby creatures: Wis save or Disadvantage attacking others).
Cast Misty Step as a Reaction when damaged; new options Disappearing Step (Invisible until your next turn) and Dreadful Step (Wis save or 2d10 Psychic near you).
Immune to Charmed. Reaction when hit: halve the damage, attacker makes a Wis save or takes Psychic damage equal to what you took. 1/Long Rest or a Pact slot.
After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, cast Misty Step free as part of that action.
Always prepared — L3: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame; L5: Daylight, Revivify; L7: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire; L9: Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial
Pool of d6s = 1 + Warlock level; Bonus Action: heal a creature within 60 ft with up to Cha mod dice. Long Rest.
Resistance to Radiant; once per turn add Cha mod to one Fire or Radiant spell damage roll.
After Magical Cunning or a rest, gain temp HP = Warlock level + Cha mod; up to 5 others gain half Warlock level + Cha mod.
When you or an ally within 60 ft makes a Death Save, restore it to half HP max; enemies within 30 ft take 2d8 + Cha Radiant and are Blinded. 1/Long Rest.
Bonus Action: telepathic link with a creature within 30 ft for minutes = Warlock level.

Always prepared — L3: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter; L5: Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar; L7: Confusion, Summon Aberration; L9: Modify Memory, Telekinesis
Damaging Warlock spells can deal Psychic instead; Enchantment/Illusion Warlock spells need no Verbal/Somatic components.
When you link via Awakened Mind, target makes a Wis save or has Disadvantage attacking you and you have Advantage on it. 1/Short or Long Rest or a Pact slot.
Hex always prepared; the target has Disadvantage on saves of the ability you chose.
Your thoughts can't be read; Resistance to Psychic; creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same.
Summon Aberration without Concentration (1 min); it gains temp HP = Warlock level + Cha and its first hit each turn on your Hex target adds Hex damage.
Bonus Action, 1 min: 1d10 + Warlock level temp HP, immune to Frightened, once per turn a hit forces a Wis save or Frightened. Cha mod uses per Long Rest.
Always prepared — L3: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness; L5: Speak with Dead, Summon Undead; L7: Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer; L9: Antilife Shell, Cloudkill

Your Necrotic damage ignores Resistance; once per turn change a spell's damage to Necrotic; in Form of Dread roll an extra Necrotic die once per turn; no Exhaustion from hunger, thirst or suffocation and no need to sleep.
Resistance to Necrotic (immunity in Form of Dread). At 0 HP: 30-ft burst, Con save 2d10 + Cha Necrotic, then HP = 2× Warlock level and 1 Exhaustion. 1/Short or Long Rest.
In Form of Dread: Resistance to B/P/S, Fly Speed (hover) and move through creatures/objects; Conjuration/Necromancy Warlock spells need no V/S/M components (except costly).

Small Celestial, Fiend or Undead (AC 13 + Cha, HP 4 + 4× Warlock level, hover 30 ft). Dodges unless commanded (Bonus Action or trade an attack): Vestige's Strike 1d6 + 3 + Cha (Fire/Necrotic/Radiant). 1/day Divine Power: Healing Touch, Fiendish Swap or Cursed Invocation. Revive with a 1-minute ceremony.

Always prepared — L3: Pick a Cleric domain — Life: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration | Light: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility | Trickery: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace | War: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon; L5: Life: Mass Healing Word, Revivify | Light: Daylight, Fireball | Trickery: Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection | War: Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians; L7: Life: Aura of Life, Death Ward | Light: Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire | Trickery: Confusion, Dimension Door | War: Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement; L9: Life: Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds | Light: Flame Strike, Scrying | Trickery: Dominate Person, Modify Memory | War: Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike
Divine Power recharges on a Short/Long Rest and when you use Magical Cunning; within 30 ft of the vestige you share its damage Resistance.
Reaction when the vestige would drop to 0 HP: spend a Pact slot to restore it to full and teleport it 30 ft. 1/Long Rest.
Magic action, 1 hour: transform the vestige into a Celestial/Fiendish/Undead spirit (as Summon spells, level = half Warlock level) with temp HP equal to that form's HP. 1/Long Rest.
Add two Abjuration spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.

Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot creates a ward (HP = 2× Wizard level + Int) that absorbs your damage (1/Long Rest). Recharge it by 2× slot level per Abjuration spell, or Bonus Action spend a slot.
Reaction: your ward absorbs damage taken by a creature within 30 ft.
Counterspell and Dispel Magic always prepared; Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action; add PB to their checks; slot not spent if they fail.
Advantage on saves vs spells; Resistance to spell damage.

Bonus Action, 1 min (no armor/Shield): +Int AC, +10 ft Speed, Advantage on Acrobatics, use Int for weapon attacks/damage, add Int to Concentration saves. Int mod uses per Long Rest; regain one with Arcane Recovery.
Proficiency with Martial melee weapons lacking Two-Handed/Heavy; use them as a focus; proficiency in Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.
Attack twice; replace one attack with a Wizard cantrip.
Reaction while Bladesong is active: expend a slot to reduce damage by 5× slot level.
After casting a spell with an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
Bonus Action: teleport 30 ft, or swap places with a willing Medium-or-smaller creature. Int mod uses per Long Rest.
Add two Conjuration spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.
Benign Transposition range 60 ft; spend a level 3+ slot to regain a use.
Creatures you summon/create with a Conjuration slot spell get temp HP = 2× Wizard level and, while they have it, Resistance to all damage except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant.
Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.
A Conjuration slot spell that summons a stat-block spirit summons two (each at half HP). 1/Long Rest or level 5+ slot.
Add two Divination spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.
After a Long Rest roll two d20s; replace any D20 Test by you or a creature you can see with one of them.
Casting a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot restores a lower-level slot (max level 5).
Bonus Action until rest: Darkvision 120 ft, read any language, or See Invisibility. 1/Short or Long Rest.
Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation or Persuasion; add Int mod to checks with it.
Add two Enchantment spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.
Magic action: a creature within 10 ft makes a Wis save or is Charmed (Incapacitated, Speed 0) for 1 min; ends on damage or distance. Int mod uses per Long Rest.
When an Enchantment slot spell can be upcast for extra targets, treat it as 1 level higher for free. Int mod uses per Long Rest.
Reaction when hit by a creature within 30 ft: Wis save or the attack misses / is redirected to another creature in range. 1/Long Rest; recharges when you cast an Enchantment slot spell.
A creature you Charm with a slot spell doesn't know it's Charmed; once, Magic action: Int save or it loses up to 1 + Int mod hours of memory.
Add two Illusion spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.
Illusion spells need no Verbal components and gain +60 ft range; Minor Illusion as a Bonus Action with sound and image together.
Summon Beast and Summon Fey always prepared and can be Illusions; cast each once per Long Rest without a slot (half HP).
Reaction: an attack against you automatically misses. 1/Short or Long Rest or level 2+ slot.
After casting an Illusion spell with a slot, make one inanimate nonmagical object in it real for 1 min (Bonus Action).
Add two Necromancy spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.
Resistance to Necrotic; Find Familiar can be a Skeleton or Zombie (trade an attack for its Reaction attack); Necromancy slot spells heal an Undead within 60 ft by slot level + Wizard level.
Arcane Recovery also removes 1 Exhaustion; your Wizard spells/features ignore Necrotic Resistance.
Animate Dead always prepared; cast free 1/Long Rest and upcast it by 1 level. Your Undead gain HP = Int mod + half Wizard level and +Int mod Necrotic on hits.
Reaction when you become Bloodied: destroy one of your Undead to regain HP = Wizard level.
Bonus Action: your summoned Undead within 60 ft gain temp HP = Wizard level (1/Long Rest). Undead that drop to 0 HP can explode (10 ft, Dex save, d6s = half its Hit Dice Necrotic).
Add two Transmutation spells (level 2 or lower) free; one more free each new slot level.

After a Long Rest craft a stone (spellcasting focus): bearer gains Con save proficiency plus Darkvision 60, a damage Resistance (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison/Thunder) or +10 ft Speed. Re-pick when you cast a Transmutation slot spell.
Alter Self always prepared; cast free 1/Long Rest with an extra perk per option (Dash as BA underwater, Advantage on Deception, 2d6 natural weapons + Concentration Advantage).
Transmutation slot spells without an attack roll or save are cast 1 level higher. Int mod uses per Long Rest.
Stone holds two benefits; new options Mighty Build (Advantage on Str saves, larger carry) and Tremorsense 30 ft.
Polymorph always prepared; cast free 1/Long Rest. On yourself, keep your mental scores/features, or keep casting Transmutation spells.
Magic action: consume the stone (or spend a level 7+ slot to keep it) for Major Transformation, Panacea (heal half HP max, cure curses/disease), Restore Life (Raise Dead free) or Restore Youth.
